name: laita
description: Proofread and rewrite text with a language model running locally in Ollama. Nothing leaves your machine.

commands.title: LAITA: Proofread the paragraph at the cursor
LAITA: Also check this file (and show its language id)
LAITA: Forget suggestions I told it never to make

laita.model.description: Model to use. A 7-9B instruction model is the sweet spot.

laita.numCtx.description: Context window. 0 follows Ollama's own setting, which avoids evicting a model another app has loaded.

laita.keepAlive.description: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded. Needs a unit; -1m means indefinitely.

laita.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for one request. A transform is allowed longer in proportion to the selection.

laita.think.description: Let reasoning models think before answering. Much slower.

laita.checkOnType.description: Proofread the paragraph you are writing in, shortly after you stop typing. Only in the languages listed below.

laita.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before checking.

laita.checkOnSave.description: Proofread the whole document when it is saved.

laita.languages.markdownDescription:
File types checked automatically, given as VS Code **language identifiers** — not file extensions. `markdown`, not `.md`.

To find the identifier for a file you have open, run **LAITA: Also check this file**: it tells you the id and offers to add it here. You can also click the language name at the right of the status bar, or see the [full list of identifiers](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/identifiers).

Anything not listed is left alone, but the LAITA commands still work on it.

laita.maxChars.description: Maximum characters one check or transform may send.

laita.chunkMaxChars.description: Paragraphs longer than this are split on sentence boundaries.

laita.language.description: Language of the text, or 'auto' to detect it (e.g. en, fr, it).

laita.categories.style.description: Report weak style (wordiness, redundancy, passive voice).

laita.extraInstructions.description: House style rules appended to the prompt.

laita.transformDefault.description: Instruction used when the transform box is submitted empty.

laita.dictionary.description: Words never to flag. Grows when you use 'Add to dictionary'.

laita.ignored.description: Fingerprints of suggestions you asked never to see again. Cleared by the 'Forget' command.
